description: This file defines functions and constants related to rendering and managing scrollbars within a scene, including calculating scrollbar positions, sizes, and detecting hover over scrollbars in an interactive drawing application.

methods.name: getScrollBars
methods.description: Calculates the positions and sizes of horizontal and vertical scrollbars based on scene elements, viewport size, zoom, and safe area margins.

methods.name: isOverScrollBars
methods.description: Determines if a given (x, y) coordinate is over either the horizontal or vertical scrollbar.
